description: 新北市事業廢棄物再利用者登記資料 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府環境保護局. 取得目的事業主管機關再利用許可之事業或依中央目的事業主管機關所定再利用管理辦法公告之管理方式收受事業廢棄物進行再利用之事業,並經新北市政府敬保護局核發再利用機構管制編號. Coverage: 新北市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
